definition: Time-lord systems answer 'why now' by dividing a life into chapters, each governed by a planet whose natal condition colors that span. Transits only matter when they activate the period's lord.

annualProfections.definition: Each year of life advances the focus one whole sign from the Ascendant. The ruler of the profected sign is the Lord of the Year.

computation.profectedSign: the sign that many whole signs from the natal Ascendant, counterclockwise
computation.lordOfYear: the domicile ruler of the profected sign (use dignity.domicile)
computation.monthly: from the annual profected sign, advance one sign per ~month (12 over the year) for the Lord of the Month
computation.daily: subdivide the month the same way for a Lord of the Day

interpretationRules: The year's topics are read from the profected house (see houseTopics).
The Lord of the Year's natal condition (house, sign, dignity, sect, aspects) sets the year's quality.
That year, transits TO or FROM the Lord of the Year and TO the profected sign are the ones that fire; others are background.
If the Lord of the Year is also currently transited by a malefic, weight the year's difficulty up; by a benefic, down.
A profection to a house activates the planets natally in that house and the planet ruling it.

houseTopics.1: self, body, vitality, the year's overall direction
houseTopics.3: siblings, neighbors, short trips, daily communication, learning
houseTopics.4: home, family, parents, foundations, property, endings
houseTopics.6: work, routine, health, illness, subordinates, daily grind
houseTopics.7: marriage, partners, clients, open enemies, one-to-one dealings
houseTopics.8: shared resources, debt, other people's money, crisis, death, transformation
houseTopics.9: travel, foreigners, higher learning, religion, philosophy, publishing
houseTopics.10: career, action, reputation, public standing, authority
houseTopics.11: friends, allies, groups, patrons, hopes and goals, gains
houseTopics.12: seclusion, loss, hidden things, self-undoing, hidden enemies, retreat

zodiacalReleasing.definition: Releases time from a Lot through the signs, each sign lasting its ruler's period-years, producing nested life chapters (L1 major, L2 sub, L3, L4).

lots.spirit: career, action, mind, reputation, the volitional life

zodiacalReleasing.signPeriodNote: Each sign's L1 length equals its ruler's period-years (Cancer=Moon 25, Leo=Sun 19, etc.). L2 subdivides that span through all twelve signs in order.
mechanics: Start L1 at the sign of the Lot; advance through signs in order, each lasting its signPeriodYears.
Within each L1, run L2 through all twelve signs, each L2 lasting its own signPeriodYears, scaled into the L1 span.
'Loosing of the bond': when an L2 run completes the zodiac and would pass the sign opposite its start, it jumps to that opposite sign instead. Marks a major turning point.
Peak periods: L2 periods whose sign is angular (1st/4th/7th/10th) to the Lot of Fortune are high-activity 'peak' times; signs in aversion to the Lot are low/quiet.
interpretationRules: Read Spirit-based ZR for career and chosen action; Fortune-based for body, health, and circumstance.
The current L1/L2 ruling sign and its lord describe the chapter's theme; the lord's natal condition sets its quality.
Treat MVP use as advisory background ('what season of life'), not a daily trigger.
zodiacalReleasing.note: Advanced; structured here for later. Not required for the daily MVP, but the period numbers and peak rule are enough to compute chapters.
